content.title: Carisma Therapeutics, OrthoCellix enter definitive merger agreement
content.summary: Carisma Therapeutics (CARM) and OrthoCellix, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Ocugen (OCGN), announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement to combine the companies in an all-stock transaction. The combined company will focus on the development of OrthoCellix’s NeoCart technology for the treatment of knee articular cartilage defects and plans to initiate a U.S. Food and Drug Administration-endorsed Phase 3 clinical trial for NeoCart.
